name: The LAB Miami
description: Wynwood-based coworking space and entrepreneurial community that hosts events and programs for founders and tech professionals.

name: Venture Café Miami
description: Nonprofit known for its free weekly Thursday Gathering networking events for Miami's innovation and startup community.

name: Refresh Miami
description: Nonprofit tech community that publishes South Florida tech news and an events calendar and runs meetups and workshops for founders and tech workers.

name: Women in Miami Tech
description: Community group for women working in or entering Miami's tech industry, with networking events listed on Refresh Miami's calendar.

name: eMerge Americas
description: Annual Miami tech conference connecting startups, investors and corporates from the US, Latin America and Europe; check the official site for dates.

name: The AI Collective – Miami Chapter
description: Miami chapter of The AI Collective, a global grassroots community that hosts events for builders, researchers and founders working with AI.

name: Code for Miami
description: Volunteer civic-tech group that has worked on open-source projects with local government and community organizations.

name: Endeavor Miami
description: Local affiliate of the global Endeavor network that selects and supports high-impact scale-up founders with mentorship and network access.

name: StartUP FIU
description: Florida International University's entrepreneurship hub offering accelerator programs and resources for founders from FIU and the wider community.

name: The Launch Pad at University of Miami
description: University of Miami's venture-creation program providing coaching and mentoring for UM students and alumni starting businesses.

name: Miami-Dade Beacon Council
description: Miami-Dade County's official economic development partnership, helping companies relocate, expand and connect with local resources.

name: CIC Miami (Cambridge Innovation Center)
description: Innovation campus offering coworking, private offices and community events for startups and innovation teams.

name: Babson College Miami
description: Babson College's Miami location offering graduate business and entrepreneurship programs for working professionals.

name: Center for Black Innovation
description: Miami nonprofit (formerly Code Fever Miami) that provides startup and investor education and community for Black tech entrepreneurs.

name: Black Women Talk Tech
description: National community for Black women tech founders that runs events and programming, with a strong Miami presence.

name: Miami Fintech
description: Industry association for Miami's financial technology ecosystem, organizing events that connect fintech founders, professionals and institutions.

name: HIMSS South Florida Chapter
description: Regional chapter of HIMSS, the health information and technology association, offering networking and education for health-tech professionals.

name: Florida Restaurant & Lodging Association (FRLA)
description: Statewide hospitality trade association with regional chapters offering industry networking, food-safety training and workforce programs.

name: Greater Miami Chamber of Commerce
description: One of Miami's largest business associations, running networking events, leadership programs and advocacy for local businesses.

name: Miami-Dade Chamber of Commerce
description: Chamber focused on advancing Black-owned businesses and economic development in Miami-Dade through networking, advocacy and programs.

name: CAMACOL – Latin Chamber of Commerce of the USA
description: Miami-based Hispanic business chamber supporting Latin American and Hispanic entrepreneurs with networking, trade events and advocacy.

name: SCORE Miami-Dade
description: Local SCORE chapter offering free one-on-one mentoring from volunteer business mentors plus low-cost workshops for small business owners.

name: Florida SBDC at FIU
description: Small Business Development Center at FIU providing no-cost consulting and training to help Miami-Dade small businesses start and grow.

name: Prospera
description: Nonprofit providing bilingual business consulting, training and access-to-capital support for Hispanic entrepreneurs in Florida.

name: Catalyst Miami
description: Nonprofit offering financial coaching, benefits access, civic leadership training and community programs for low-income Miami-Dade residents.

name: Miami-Dade Public Library System – Learning & Training
description: Free classes, English conversation and ESL resources, job help and online learning platforms available with a library card at branches across the county.
cost_note: Free with a Miami-Dade library card

name: Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Miami
description: Social service agency offering immigration legal services, refugee resettlement support and other community programs in South Florida.

name: Church World Service – Miami
description: Refugee and immigrant services office providing resettlement, employment and integration support to newcomers in Miami.

name: Lutheran Services Florida
description: Statewide social services nonprofit whose programs include refugee and immigrant services in South Florida.

name: Florida Immigrant Coalition (FLIC)
description: Statewide coalition advocating for immigrant rights and sharing know-your-rights information and community resources.

name: Miami-Dade County Office of Innovation & Economic Development
description: County office supporting small businesses and economic development, including resources for local entrepreneurs.

name: City of Miami – Business Resources
description: City of Miami portal for business licensing (Business Tax Receipts) and resources for starting a business within city limits.

name: CareerSource South Florida
description: Public workforce board with career centers across Miami-Dade offering job search help, workshops and referrals to funded training.

name: CareerSource South Florida – Training Funding (WIOA)
description: Training scholarships and incentives that can pay for approved occupational training for eligible job seekers.
cost_note: Free for eligible residents via WIOA funding

name: Miami Dade College – Continuing Education
description: Non-credit workforce and personal enrichment courses at MDC campuses and online, including short professional certificates.

name: MDC EnTec – IT, Networking & Cybersecurity Certificates
description: Miami Dade College's School of Engineering and Technology offers college credit certificates and degrees in cybersecurity, networking and cloud computing.

name: MDC EnTec – Data Analytics
description: Data analytics credentials at Miami Dade College's School of Engineering and Technology covering data tools, SQL and Python.

name: MDC Artificial Intelligence Programs
description: Miami Dade College offers artificial intelligence credentials and degrees through its School of Engineering and Technology.

name: MDC Medical Campus – Allied Health Certificates
description: Miami Dade College's Medical Campus offers healthcare certification programs including medical assisting, phlebotomy, pharmacy technician and medical coder/biller.

name: MDC Medical Coder/Biller
description: Miami Dade College Medical Campus program preparing students to code and bill medical records for healthcare providers.

name: MDC Pharmacy Technician
description: Miami Dade College Medical Campus program training pharmacy technicians for retail and hospital pharmacies.

name: MDC Phlebotomy
description: Short Miami Dade College Medical Campus program training students to draw and handle blood specimens.

name: MDC Medical Assisting
description: Miami Dade College Medical Campus program preparing medical assistants for clinical and administrative work in physician offices.

name: MDC Supply Chain Management & Logistics
description: Miami Dade College business programs in supply chain management, logistics and supply chain analytics, relevant to Miami's port and airport economy.

name: MDC Miami International Hospitality Center
description: Miami Dade College's hospitality center offering programs in hospitality and tourism management and related industry training.

name: MDC MAGIC (Miami Animation & Gaming International Complex)
description: Miami Dade College's center for animation, game development and digital media programs.

name: MDC Works – Career Services
description: Miami Dade College's career services office helping students and alumni with job search, internships and employer connections.

name: FIU Continuing Education – Non-Credit Certificates
description: FIU's non-credit professional certificates in areas such as project management, business analytics and digital marketing, largely online.

name: FIU Chaplin School of Hospitality & Tourism Management
description: FIU's hospitality school offering degree and professional programs in hospitality, tourism and restaurant management.

name: Lindsey Hopkins Technical College
description: Miami-Dade County Public Schools technical college offering career and technical programs, with a strong focus on health careers, plus adult education.

name: The English Center (TEC)
description: Miami-Dade County Public Schools adult education center and technical college founded to serve refugees, offering ESOL, GED, citizenship and career programs.

name: M-DCPS Adult & Career Technical Education
description: Miami-Dade County Public Schools adult education offering ESOL, GED and career technical programs at technical colleges and adult centers countywide.

name: Robert Morgan Educational Center and Technical College
description: M-DCPS technical college in South Miami-Dade offering career and technical certificate programs for adults.

name: George T. Baker Aviation Technical College
description: M-DCPS technical college near Miami International Airport training aviation maintenance technicians.

name: D.A. Dorsey Technical College
description: M-DCPS technical college in Liberty City/Brownsville area offering career and technical programs and adult education.

name: Miami Lakes Technical College
description: M-DCPS technical college offering adult career and technical training in skilled trades and other fields.

name: ABC Institute – Construction Apprenticeships (ABC Florida East Coast)
description: Education arm of the Associated Builders and Contractors Florida East Coast Chapter offering registered earn-while-you-learn apprenticeships in construction trades, with a Miami campus.

name: IEC Florida East Coast Chapter – Electrical Apprenticeship
description: Independent Electrical Contractors chapter running an electrical apprenticeship school where apprentices work for contractors while taking classes.

name: IBEW Local 349 – Electrical Apprenticeship
description: Miami electrical workers' union whose joint apprenticeship program trains inside wiremen through paid on-the-job work and classroom instruction.

name: Gold Coast Schools – Florida Real Estate Sales Associate Course
description: Florida real estate school offering the state-required 63-hour sales associate pre-licensing course in classroom and online formats.

name: Florida Real Estate Commission (DBPR) – Licensing
description: State regulator explaining Florida real estate license requirements, including the 63-hour pre-licensing course and state exam.

name: Goodwill Industries of South Florida – Job Services
description: Nonprofit providing job training, placement and employment services, with a focus on people with disabilities and other barriers to work.

name: 4Geeks Academy
description: Miami-founded coding bootcamp offering full-stack development, data science and cybersecurity programs, and a workforce training partner of Miami Dade College.

name: Ironhack
description: Tech bootcamp offering web development, UX/UI design, data analytics and cybersecurity programs; Miami classes now appear to be offered remotely.

name: General Assembly
description: Online tech education provider offering bootcamps and short courses in software engineering, data, UX design and digital marketing.

name: Google Career Certificates
description: Self-paced online certificates from Google in IT support, data analytics, cybersecurity, project management and UX design, designed for beginners.

name: Miami Ad School
description: Portfolio school for advertising and creative careers, offering programs in copywriting, art direction, design and strategy.
